contradictions.description: The 2026-06-30 AP aging totals $76,587.72, while the trial balance reports Accounts Payable of $92,731.15. The $16,143.43 difference equals the unpaid remainder of opening AP ($32,286.85 less the $16,143.42 payment), indicating that the dated AP aging omits a material opening-balance payable.

w07-accrual_schedule.reason: The May prepaid schedule and contracts define the prepaid population, opening balances, June additions, full-month amortization, closing balances, and the combined supporting journal entry.

w07-bank_rec.reason: The bank statement, GL, and trial balance provide sufficient transaction-level information to identify outstanding checks, deposits in transit, the unrecorded bank fee and interest, and a unique adjusted cash balance.

w07-journal_entries.reason: The payroll register, prepaid support, fixed-asset register, vendor bills, and GL provide sufficient information to identify missing entries while avoiding duplicate depreciation or cash-side corrections.

w07-variance_analysis.reason: June actuals can be derived from the GL and adjusted for the specified close entries, while the June budget and supporting documents identify the principal one-off variance drivers. Materiality requires ordinary professional judgment but does not prevent a defensible analysis.
